rulers.name: Louis the Blind (Louis III of Provence)
rulers.title: King of Italy (rival)

ledger.x: 19 September 855: the Treaty of Prum gives Louis II Italy.
863: Louis II receives Provence.
875: Provence leaves the Italian crown.
887: the royal seat moves to Verona.
November 887: Charles the Fat is deposed and Berengar of Friuli takes Italy.
889: Guy of Spoleto wins the crown.
889: the Trebbia.
894-896: the Carolingians briefly hold Italy.
896: Arnulf's army in Italy.
898: the north-east is Berengar's again.
October 898: Berengar becomes sole king.
October 898: the war with Spoleto ends with Lambert's death.
900: Louis the Blind invades Italy.
21 July 905: Louis is captured at Verona and blinded.
29 July 923: Rudolf II beats Berengar at Fiorenzuola.
7 April 924: Berengar I is murdered at Verona.
925: the capital returns to Pavia.
926: Rudolf II is driven out.
926: Hugh of Arles is crowned king of Italy.
928: Hugh annexes Provence to Italy de facto.
933: Provence handed to Rudolf.
951: Otto I invades.
952: the March of Verona goes to Bavaria.
952: the invasion settles.
961: Otto I conquers Pavia and is proclaimed king of Italy.
961: the Italian kingdom passes to the German king.

wars.name: Louis II's capture of Bari
wars.outcome: Bari 'succumbed in 871' with Louis II's help; he was 'robbed and imprisoned by Adelchis, prince of Benevento, in August 871'.

wars.name: Berengar I against Guy and Lambert of Spoleto
wars.outcome: Guy won at the Trebbia in early 889 and held the crown; Arnulf and Berengar beat him at Bergamo in 894; Lambert's death on 15 October 898 left Berengar sole ruler.

wars.name: Arnulf of Carinthia's Italian campaigns
wars.outcome: The Carolingians 'briefly regained the throne in 894-896' (Kingdom page); Berengar, Arnulf's vassal since 888, was with Arnulf's army in 896.

wars.name: Hungarian invasion of Italy (899)
wars.outcome: 'They invaded Italy first in 899'; Berengar's army 'was surprised and routed near the Brenta River' on 24 September 899.

wars.name: Louis the Blind's invasions of Italy
wars.outcome: Louis defeated Berengar in 900; Berengar defeated him at Verona, captured and blinded him on 21 July 905.

wars.name: Rudolf II's war for Italy
wars.outcome: Rudolf II, invited in 921, beat Berengar at Fiorenzuola on 29 July 923; Berengar was murdered on 7 April 924; Hugh was elected in 925 and Rudolf was ejected in 926.

wars.name: Berengar of Ivrea against Hugh
wars.outcome: Hugh expelled Berengar of Ivrea in 941; Berengar returned from Germany in 945 and defeated Hugh; by 947 'much of the real power' was in Berengar's hands.

wars.name: Otto I's invasions of Italy
wars.outcome: Otto invaded in 951 and proclaimed himself king; the March of Verona went to Bavaria in 952; he conquered Pavia in 961 and was crowned emperor in 962.

certainty.note: The Treaty of Prum of 855 divided the Middle Kingdom among Lothair I's sons, but the pages give the Italian frontier only by regions and cities, never by line; the March of Verona (952) is the one boundary named.
